title: I Stand at the Door
question: Who is Jesus knocking for in this letter, and what is He asking?
blurb: A door, a knock, and a shared meal. See what Scripture says about who opens it.

nodes.content: Who is Jesus knocking for in this letter, and what is He asking?

nodes.verseText: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.
Those I love I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.

Blessed are those servants whom the master finds on watch when he returns. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve and will have them recline at the table, and he himself will come and wait on them.
Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
